title: HIVE crosses $1 million in daily revenue from mining and AI cloud
excerpt: HIVE crosses $1 million in combined daily revenue from Bitcoin mining and AI cloud services for the first time.
content_html:
HIVE Digital Technologies (Nasdaq: HIVE), a Canada-based Bitcoin miner and data center operator that trades on the Nasdaq and Toronto Stock Exchange, said it has exceeded $1 million in daily revenue on Aug. 21.

The milestone combined income from Bitcoin mining and GPU cloud services for the first time at that level, according to preliminary, unaudited management estimates.

Since that date, the company has produced an average of approximately 12 Bitcoin per day, representing roughly 2% of global Bitcoin network production.

Its GPU cloud operations, run through wholly owned subsidiary BUZZ HPC, a sovereign AI cloud and high-performance computing provider, have generated approximately $100,000 in average daily revenue over the same period.

Related: Man declares bankruptcy with 34 cents while hiding millions

Two revenue engines running in parallel

Bitcoin mining provides the bulk of HIVE's daily income, the company earns revenue by using computing power to process transactions on the Bitcoin network and receiving newly minted coins as a reward.

BUZZ HPC is building a separate, recurring revenue stream by selling access to GPU-powered computing infrastructure to enterprise, government and research clients under long-term contracts.

Year to date, BUZZ HPC has closed more than $600 million in total contract value for GPU cloud deals, including three- and five-year agreements with creditworthy counterparties, with a demand pipeline exceeding $1 billion.

Trending on TheStreet Roundtable:

  • Coinbase CEO doubles down on bullish Bitcoin target

  • Bankrupt ATM network sells 2,446 machines below $1M

  • Roundtable 100 analyst upgrades Adobe ranking as AI revenue triples

Swedish mining heading for wind-down

HIVE also said it plans to wind down Bitcoin mining at its Swedish facilities, which represented less than 5% of global daily revenue during August. The company is evaluating repurposing that infrastructure for higher-value HPC and AI applications instead.

The shift signals how HIVE is reallocating energy resources, mining remains the larger revenue contributor today, but contracted AI cloud revenue is increasingly where the company sees its long-term growth.
